purpose: Separate input-range sensitivity of the DNN from amplitude sensitivity of the normal-only detector.

DNN_modes.P0: Original raw float32 features followed by train-only StandardScaler and explicit float32 transform.

P1.features: RMS, spectral energy and dominant amplitude at DE and FE
P1.formula: log1p(float32(x_j / a_j)) computed as explicit float32 division then float32 log1p
P1.a_j: float64 median of strictly positive values in the corresponding raw float32 training column; export float32
P1.negative_nonfinite_or_overflow: stop; no abs, clipping, epsilon search or silent repair
P1.after_compression: StandardScaler fitted only on transformed training data, stats float64 exported float32

reference_import_policy: Keep the original source job, signature and seals. Verify identical roles, ordered IDs, mask, seed, training core, environment and identity preprocessing. Do not rewrite as a new fit.
training_unchanged: d-20-10-3, Adam0.005, batch32, weighted training CE+L2, unweighted validation CE+L2, max50, patience10, min_delta1e-12, restore best
INT8_calibration: All corresponding transformed training rows in ascending global ID; no validation or outer rows.

DNN_comparison.paired_unit: same mask, inner validation load and seed
DNN_comparison.aggregation: nine paired scores per mask, equal three seeds and three loads
secondary: clipped value and window fractions with denominators
DNN_comparison.promising_for_followup_engineering_crite: Mean paired INT8 macro-F1 gain >=0.01, with no inner load mean loss >0.01 versus P0; report each mask separately.

normality_secondary_block.data_space: Original raw features; DNN P1 compression never applied implicitly
normality_secondary_block.MOM4_meaning: DE/FE skewness and kurtosis; positive affine gain/offset invariant under the feature definitions, not arbitrary signal or polarity changes
normality_secondary_block.entropy_excluded_reason: Bounded temporal-moment control without FFT; entropy is also amplitude invariant but not included in this small control.
normality_secondary_block.roles: Same normal fit/calibration disjoint MAT as original V2 in each inner fold; max permitted training load calibrates P95; no refit
normality_secondary_block.threshold: Existing equal-record empirical P95, no interpolation; reject score strictly above threshold
normality_secondary_block.descriptive_engineering_guard: Normal specificity, IR recall and OR recall each >=0.95 in each internal validation load
normality_secondary_block.future_cost_guard: If adopted, define union of DNN/detector features and remeasure full pipeline; MOM4 is shared in F14/NF12 but not in every original candidate.

first_user_execution: One new P1 F14 seed11 inner0 fit, with two original P0 references registered; 3/36 cells available afterwards.
